name: umo-jira-tracker
description: UMO JIRA Tracker — links JIRA issues to a local Beads database on the org's five-type work-tracking model (Flow, Slice, Task, Request, Bug), drives commit/MR creation with the mandatory JIRA key, and syncs results back to JIRA on bead close.

interface.shortDescription: JIRA↔Beads bridge on the five-type work model, commit/MR creation, and JIRA sync-back.
interface.longDescription: Automates the daily developer JIRA workflow on the org's canonical work-tracking model: pulls Flows, Slices, Tasks, Bugs and Requests into a local Beads database, guides bead-by-bead work with AC drafting, creates GitLab MRs via glab (or GitLab MCP) with the mandatory JIRA key, and syncs outcomes back to JIRA — all with explicit approval gates. It creates Tasks and Bugs under a Slice and nothing else: Flows, Slices and Requests are the flow PM's to author, and the execution plan inside one Task stays in git.
defaultPrompt: Run /umo-jira-tracker:sync to pull my unresolved JIRA issues into Beads.
Run /umo-jira-tracker:work PAY-1234 to start working on a task.
Run /umo-jira-tracker:mr to create a GitLab MR and update JIRA.
Run /umo-jira-tracker:close to close the bead and transition JIRA.
